claims.text: Orville flew on December 17, 1903, approximately 10:35 a.m., for 12 seconds over 120 feet.
claims.limits: Institutional retrospective support; not two independent witnesses.

claims.text: Wilbur made the fourth flight, covering 852 feet in 59 seconds.
Wind damaged the flyer after the fourth flight; a telegram was later sent to the brothers’ father.
The brothers valued an exact modest record over an inflated description.
claims.reason: Interpretation of the institutional account’s description of a matter-of-fact telegram, not evidence of private motive.

claims.text: The plan after lunch was to travel to the postmaster by airplane.
claims.reason: S2 uses wording that appears to imply flight despite ending the season after damage; S3 says only that a telegram was sent. Possible narrative sequencing or colloquial wording; not resolved from these sources. Omitted from screenplay.
